spec.moment: Making tamales all afternoon with my grandmother in her kitchen while old boleros played on the radio.

elements.name: abuela
elements.look: a small elderly woman in a pale blue apron and a soft lilac cardigan, hair in a low bun, standing at the table folding corn husks

elements.name: tamales

elements.name: corn husks

elements.name: yellow flowers

spec.scene: A small patch of warm terracotta kitchen floor with a worn wooden work table at its center, where a grandmother in a lilac cardigan and pale blue apron folds pale green corn husks beside a stack of finished tamales, one open to show golden masa. To the left a woven basket holds three mangos, one cut orange; at the front a paper-wrapped bunch of yellow flowers rests with loose petals on the counter. At the back edge a stove fragment and a shelf with a small radio glowing amber, afternoon sun falling in a warm stripe across the table.
spec.title: Tamales en la Cocina
spec.caption: Hicimos tamales toda la tarde mientras la radio cantaba boleros.
